opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: up to £56,000 in year one, up to £28,000 in years two and three, plus up to £6,000 per annum for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must not have held a full‑time permanent academic post, must hold a doctorate, must have submitted their doctoral thesis for viva by the closing date, must be based at a UK university (or have a UK degree), and must not have extensive postdoctoral experience exceeding three years.
opportunities.summary: Supports early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable research.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities, other UK higher‑education institutions and, on a trial basis, UK‑based independent research institutes/organisations are eligible.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative, original research projects up to five years in duration.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be made by a member of academic staff at a UK university with research degree awarding powers (or specialist arts institutions) who will coordinate the visit.
opportunities.summary: Invite an eminent overseas senior professor to provide novel expertise and enhance skills at a UK institution.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with at least two years post‑PhD experience, holding a permanent UK academic appointment at lecturer level (or nominated by a UK university). Must be resident in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Supports talented early‑career scholars to build a modest research team and demonstrate research leadership.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree awarding powers may be principal applicants; collaborative centres are encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Supports large‑scale research centres to achieve a step‑change in scholarship across any discipline.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: research expenses up to £6,000 per annum

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Well‑established distinguished researchers in the humanities or social sciences, employed at a UK university with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Supports established scholars to complete a piece of original research.
discipline_tags: Humanities and social sciences (excluding medical/clinical research)

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired senior researchers who have lived in the UK for at least 26 weeks of the year and previously held a teaching/research post at a UK university or eligible research institute.
opportunities.summary: Supports retired scholars to complete a research project and prepare results for publication.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship – Training Opportunities for Under‑18s
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities in the UK that deliver high‑quality teaching in fine and performing arts.
opportunities.summary: Funds arts training for school‑age children under 18 outside regular school hours.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship – Bursaries for Undergraduate and Postgraduate Students

amount.raw: maximum total award £475,000; bursaries £5,000–£10,000 per student per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities in the UK that offer undergraduate or postgraduate taught degrees in fine and performing arts.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries to outstanding undergraduate or postgraduate arts students in financial need.
